notes:
PASS on the fake backend. G1-G7 and G9 pass; G8 warns G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and awards CL2 because the driver declares no Limit on an actuating capability. The only bounds are catalogue class schemas: cap.world.step.v1 ticks 1..10000 and cap.world.reset.v1 seed >= 0, both refused as MHS.CAPABILITY.INPUT_INVALID rather than an envelope limit; the action vector's shape and bounds are built at runtime from the ActionMode and robot configuration passed to RoboEvalEnv.__init__ (roboeval/roboeval_env.py:73-113, roboeval/action_modes.py:233-264), a constructor option rather than a sourced device bound, so no Limit was invented. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's MujocoDriver helper cannot express the entry symbol. LiftPotPosition is a Gymnasium RoboEvalEnv that allocates its Mojo/MuJoCo world in __init__ and requires an ActionMode, not a raw MjModel; a MujocoDriver package fake would have to expose MjModel, MjData and mj_step, which are not attributes of LiftPotPosition and would fail G7. The package is therefore a direct Driver over roboeval.envs.lift_pot:LiftPotPosition with the package fake .fake:FakeLiftPotPosition, still binding cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1. The fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in: MuJoCo is not installed, the upstream package was never installed or run, and the clone was never imported. Its observation arrays are two-element placeholders; the real default proprioception length is len(robot.qpos)+len(robot.qvel) plus the gripper and floating-base fields, which depends on the BimanualPanda model and was not computed without constructing the environment. No hardware backend is declared and no hardware run was made. The acceptance gate was run once; the reference generator and the package unit tests were run before it.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
